named_method: Hybrid MARL+LNS for MAPF (a la MAPF-LNS2 + PRIMAL/SCRIMP-style MARL)

MARL_repair_operator.cooperative_reward_shaping: step penalty + BFS progress bonus + collision/blocked penalty + goal bonus

Hybrid_two_stage.iter_budget_fraction_for_MARL: marl_iters_frac=0.4 with early-stop after 5 consecutive MARL failures

deviations_explicitly_acknowledged: MARL is tabular (not a neural net) and not trained at PRIMAL/SCRIMP scale.
Q-table is trained quickly per (family, agent_count) on a single instance and reused for the rest; no large-scale curriculum.
